title: feat: show quest progress
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds optional goals to measurable quests.
- Returns progress through the existing quest check response without new storage or endpoints.
- Shows exact values and progress bars for open, claimable, and completed quests.
- Covers top-up volume, app users, and GitHub account age.
- Keeps progress optional inside quest groups and an always-present array in the public API.

Checks:
- `npx biome check`
- `npx tsc --noEmit`
- `npx vitest run test/quests.test.ts --reporter=dot` (30 tests)
- staging deployment verified

gist.headline: Quest bars grow leaves
gist.blurb: Quests now show how far along you are, because progress should not require divination. Watch your top-ups, app users, and GitHub account age inch toward their Pollen reward.
gist.summary: Measurable quests now support optional goals and return an always-present progress array in the existing quest-check response, with exact values and progress bars for top-up volume, app users, and GitHub account age.
gist.impact: Quest participants can see their current value, target, and completion progress for open, claimable, and completed quests without any new endpoint or setup.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy quest garden where progress is visible: Polli tends three code-plants growing toward marked goal posts for top-up volume, app users, and GitHub account age. A retro quest board displays chunky progress bars while flowers bloom at completed milestones, making the formerly invisible work feel measurable and rewarding.
